tw: Kron yelps and calls the animal Helpline: a camel sits on his hand!
twc: Kron 惨叫一声，打给动物热线：骆驼坐在他手上了！
hint: 被骆驼压着，打热线求救。

tw: A girl and Kron made the World Trade Center from curled paper strips.
twc: 一个女孩和 Kron 用卷起来的纸条做了座世贸中心。

tw: Kron sits alone on a stone throne holding a bone and a cone.
twc: Kron 一个人坐在石头宝座上，手里拿着骨头和冰淇淋。

tw: Kron is too weak to lift a leek, so a tiny mouse lifts it and squeaks.
twc: Kron 虚弱得拿不动一根大葱，一只小老鼠举起来吱吱叫。

tw: Dressed as a sea god, Kron nods at an odd cod on his rod.
twc: Kron 扮成海神，对着鱼竿上一条怪模怪样的鳕鱼点点头。

tw: A kitten nibbles a bit off Kron's knitted mitt until it fits.
twc: 小猫把 Kron 的毛线手套啃掉一点，啃到正合适。

tw: Kron sprinkles a little bit of glitter, and the whole city glitters.
twc: Kron 撒了一点点亮片，整座城市都闪了起来。

tw: Kron turns a turnip into a turtle, and the turtle turns Kron into a turnip.
twc: Kron 把萝卜变成乌龟，乌龟又把 Kron 变成了萝卜。
hint: 变来变去，变回自己头上。

tw: Kron objects loudly when Bob's toy jet sprays jelly on his new jacket.
twc: 鲍勃的玩具飞机把果冻喷到 Kron 新夹克上，他大声抗议。
hint: 新衣挨了果冻，坚决反对！

tw: Kron tries to hide inside the slide, but a bride rides down on him.
twc: Kron 想躲进滑梯里，结果一个新娘滑下来压在他身上。
hint: 躲得再好，也躲不过新娘。

tw: Bright night lights excite Kron, so he rides a firework into the sky.
twc: 夜晚的亮光让 Kron 激动不已，他骑着烟花冲上了天。

tw: In a western town, Kron in a vest rests in a giant bird's nest.
twc: 西部小镇里，穿马甲的 Kron 躺进巨大的鸟窝休息。

tw: Once upon a time, Kron won one big bun, and every swan in the pond stared.
twc: 从前，Kron 赢了一个大面包，池塘里的天鹅全都盯着看。
hint: 故事一开头，天鹅就盯上了。

tw: Kron's stepsister steps over his head to kiss a lizard in the pet shop.
twc: Kron 的继姐跨过他的头，去亲宠物店里的一只蜥蜴。

tw: On a tall wall above the mall, Kron and a dove fall in love.
twc: 在商场上方一堵高墙上，Kron 和一只白鸽相爱了。

tw: Kron asks Mary the hairy cow to marry him, and she carries him away.
twc: Kron 向毛茸茸的奶牛玛丽求婚，她把他叼走了。

tw: Kron's pet frog and Harry's pet ferret get married on a wet ferry.
twc: Kron 的宠物青蛙和哈利的宠物雪貂在湿漉漉的渡轮上结婚了。
hint: 证婚人 Kron 比新人还骄傲。

tw: Kron holds an old gold bowl, and a cold mole rolls out.
twc: Kron 捧着一只金色的旧碗，一只冻僵的鼹鼠滚了出来。

tw: Under the sun, a bear in a chair wears Kron's underwear on his head.
twc: 太阳底下，一头坐在椅子上的熊把 Kron 的内裤戴在头上。

tw: Nobody knows why Kron and Bobby the dog dance on the snowman's nose.
twc: 没人知道 Kron 和小狗波比为什么在雪人的鼻子上跳舞。
